title: polestar cuts full year delivery forecast after us bars china linked ev maker 2026 09 03
text:
Sept 3 (Reuters) - EV maker Polestar (PSNY.O)
, opens new tab
 on Thursday cut its full-year delivery forecast, hurt by Washington's crackdown on Chinese-linked vehicles that ​forced it out of the United States, sending its shares down ‌5.7% in premarket trading.
The Swedish company, which is majority-owned by China's Geely Holding [RIC:RIC:GEELY.UL], now expects its annual volume growth to be low-to-mid single-digit, from a previous forecast ​of low double-digit growth.
